input.prompt: A small simple royal crown made of solid cast gold, like a jeweller's casting or a die-cast badge: a plain thick band with three tall pointed tips, each tip ending in a small round gold ball, the middle tip slightly taller, a few small raised dots along the band. Bold readable silhouette that still reads when tiny. Polished high points, warm amber and deep ochre in the recesses, crisp thin dark ink contour line around it, painted comic-book illustration with the finish of a premium collectible. One warm key light from straight above and slightly in front, a faint green rim light on the left edge and a faint red rim light on the right edge. Seen perfectly head-on, front elevation, orthographic, no perspective, no tilt. Centred, filling about 75% of the width. On a perfectly flat uniform pure magenta background (#FF00FF), no shadow on the background, no floor, no gradient, no vignette. No text, no letters, no numbers, no gems, no jewels, no people.
